novelty.justification: The claim predicts that disease geometry "reflects shared pathophysiological mechanism ... beyond mere billing co-occurrence," with novelty coming from explicitly dissociating mechanism-linked pairs from demographic or coding-driven comorbidity and, secondarily, from mechanism-direction steering. Searches using “clinical concept embeddings pathophysiology versus co-occurrence,” “EHR disease embedding ontology biological mechanism,” and “comorbidity representation transformer mechanistic steering” identify close precedents in Choi et al.’s Med2Vec, Beam et al.’s clinical concept embeddings, and the retrieved patient-embedding work that reveals comorbidity patterns, but these primarily learn or validate clinical relatedness rather than isolate mechanism-aligned geometry conditional on co-occurrence. The move to curated mechanism-versus-co-occurrence contrasts and downstream-condition steering is a non-trivial, multi-step operationalization, but it is a natural extension of established embedding-similarity, ontology-alignment, and representation-steering ideas rather than a new core interpretability paradigm.
